2607.01202.title: World from Motion: Generative Dynamic Gaussian Reconstruction from Monocular Video
2607.01202.paper_summary: We present World from Motion, a method for generating freely renderable dynamic 3D Gaussian representations from monocular videos. Our approach conditions a video model on dense, pixel-aligned renderings that encode appearance, geometry, and 3D scene motion along both input and target camera trajectories to correct rendering artifacts and fill in missing regions from an initial reconstruction. To train this model, we construct a dataset of aligned multiview video pairs and dynamic 3DGS representations, with simulated artifacts characteristic of monocular reconstruction. At test time, we distill the model's generations, including newly observed regions and motions, back into a single consistent, high-quality dynamic 3DGS, improving both novel-view synthesis and the underlying 3D motion. Our method sets a new state of the art in 4D reconstruction and seamlessly generalizes to in-the-wild videos with large viewpoint changes and dynamic motions.
2607.01202.paper_summary_zh: 我們提出了 World from Motion，一種從單眼視頻生成自由可渲染動態 3D 高斯表示的方法。<lb/>我們的方法將視頻模型條件化於密集的、像素對齊的渲染，這些渲染編碼了外觀、幾何形狀和沿著輸入與目標相機軌跡的 3D 場景運動，以修正渲染伪影並填補初始重建中的缺失區域。<lb/>為了訓練這個模型，我們構建了一個對齊的多視角視頻對和動態 3DGS 表示的數據集，並模擬了單眼重建特有的伪影。<lb/>在測試時，我們將模型的生成結果，包括新觀察到的區域和運動，提煉回一個一致的高質量動態 3DGS，改善了新視角合成和基礎的 3D 運動。<lb/>我們的方法在 4D 重建中設立了新的技術標杆，並無縫地推廣到具有大視角變化和動態運動的野外視頻中。
